scope: Corrected stale saved interior-plan status, recorded two newly checked Purdue interior-location sources, and refined existing qualitative brick finish. No building mesh geometry, transforms, placement, roof, level, stair or door geometry changed.
review_findings_addressed: Corrected the saved scene/root trace-status property that was described as stale in independent review R13.
